item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
What's new

  • iCloud sync: fixed "iCloud sync could not start (SwiftDataError error 1)". Today is now signed for iCloud, and a problem in how notes link to calendar events that iCloud could not accept is fixed. Your existing planner opens unchanged.
  • iCloud sync: if iCloud cannot start, Settings now explains why in plain words.
  • Reminders: your Apple Reminders now appear in Today, Upcoming and the calendar, alongside your events. Tick them off, drag them to another day or time, edit them, or create new ones; changes go straight back to the Reminders app.
  • Reminders: show or hide each reminder list from the Calendars button or Settings ▸ Calendars, just like calendars.
  • Reminders that mirror a Today task are not shown twice, and reminders in shared read-only lists can't be changed by accident.
